correctness.rationale: The proof was reconstructed from the source-normalized torus integrals. With \(a_j=1-\cos p_j\), symmetry gives \(\langle a_1/E\rangle=1/n\) and \(\langle a_1^2/E\rangle+(n-1)\langle a_1a_2/E\rangle=1\). Combining this with \(c(0)-d(0)=\tfrac12\langle(a_1-a_2)^2/E\rangle\) and \(\sin^2p_1=a_1(2-a_1)\) yields the dimension-wide identity exactly. In two dimensions the remaining integral reduces to \(1-2/\pi\), giving the stated two couplings and hyperbola intersections. Independent quadrature and algebra reproduced the constants to numerical tolerance; that computation was corroborative only.
